reason: Customers sending jobs is useful on paper, but the upfront ID, commercial registration and approval wait is exactly the paperwork I avoid. I get paid on the day, and a 10% cut on every job plus waiting for a reviewer is a cost I have to see before I'd even try it.
objection: Uploading my ID and commercial registration and waiting for approval before I can send a single quote.
would_change_my_mind: Starting to quote and get paid right away, with the approval and document upload handled after my first job, or a clear per-job fee with no document step.
